Unless stated otherwise, every item can only be purchased once by each model. Any model with access to the Armory can buy as many items as it wants. Items with a cost of "-" can not be selected.

The model and its attached unit gain the "Acute Senses" ability.
The model receives a 6+ ward save.
All taser weapons of the model and its attached unit cause one additional hit when they trigger their Tesla ability.
The model and its attached unit gain the "Infiltrator" ability.
The model receives a 4+ ward save.
The model automatically succeeds at one roll to sing a canticle per battle round.
The model can make one additional melee attack per round. S:2 AP:-4 D:1. Hits automatically wound.
The model receives a 5+ ward save.
The model and its attached unit gains a +1 Leadership.
All rad weapons of the model and its attached unit gain an additional -1 AP.
The unit ignores the to hit penalty for Defensive fire.
The model and its attached unit gain +1" movement when using an "Advance" or "Charge" command.
The model gains a 2+ armor save. Not combinable with other armors.
The model can reroll one hit roll with this weapon per round. Must be purchased separately for each weapon.
Ranged weapons of the model and its attached unit gain -1 AP against units in cover.
All arc weapons of the model and its attached unit gain an additional AT(1).
The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Wound and the "Jump pack" rule. Only for infantry.
Enemy psykers suffer a -1 to manifestation rolls if they target the model or its attached unit directly.
All weapons of the model gain the "Cognis" ability.

One weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +6" Range (only for ranged weapons)
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army.
Enemy units receive a -2" movement penalty when charging the model or its attached unit.
The model gains +6" movement, +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, Sulphur breath and the "Bike" type. Only for infantry.
The model may use its Stasis field once per game to receive a 2+ invulverability save until its next activation. It can't use any weapons or abilities while the Stasis field is active.

A friendly unit arriving via Deep Strike within 3" of the bearer does not scatter. Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.
The model gains a cumulative instance of the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.
The model gains the ability "Furious charge".
Point costs must be paid for every model in the unit and per Wound or Hull point of the model.
The model ignores the first "Crew Shaken" vehicle damage each round.
Friendly units within 12" radius gain +1 Leadership.
The model repairs one vehicle damage (Crew Shaken, Engine Damage, Weapon Damage, Structural Damage) on a 4+ during each Reinforcement phase.
The model does not have to declare its ranged weapons at all targets before firing, and can choose a new target for each weapon.
The unit ignores the to hit penalty for Defensive fire.
Equipment such as Icons or Teleport homing beacons do not function within 12" of the model. Additionally, units arriving via Deep Strike that land within 12" roll an additional 2D6 for scattering.
If the model is under the effect of "Crew shaken", it may fire one weapon at BS 3+.
If a friendly unit within 6" gets charged by an enemy, the enemy unit does not receive any bonus (f.e. bonus attacks) for charging.

The model can use its Smoke Launcher once per game:
- During normal activation, instead of firing weapons.
- If it has not yet carried out its order this round and is targeted by an enemy unit.
Enemy units can only deal glancing hits with ranged attacks until the next activation.
